selection_process: The detailed notification sets out the selection process as follows:
Candidates will be called for a Personal Interview (PI) based on their percentage of marks in Degree / Diploma Engineering

following the reservation norms. Credentials will be checked before the Personal Interview. Candidates who do not meet the qualification will be rejected. Selected candidates must sign the Contract of Apprenticeship Training with WBPDCL online for one year of training. Interview call letters and all information will be sent only by e-mail or through the WBPDCL website. No hard copy will be posted
and no TA will be paid for attending the interview.
Important: Shortlisting is based on Degree / Diploma marks (1:5 ratio) and is followed by a Personal Interview. The notification does not print a written test.
how_to_apply: Visit the official WBPDCL website at www.wbpdcl.co.in.
Open the Careers or Recruitment section.
Find Engagement Notification No. WBPDCL/Apprentice/2026/01.
Download and read the detailed apprenticeship advertisement.
Check the eligibility requirements for the selected Engineering discipline.
If not already registered, complete the necessary NATS registration through nats.education.gov.in.
Return to the WBPDCL website and open the apprenticeship application link.
Follow the registration or login instructions displayed by the portal.
Keep ready your NATS enrolment number, a valid e-mail ID and mobile number, a scanned recent colour passport-size photograph (not more than 500KB) and a scanned signature (not more than 200KB).
Enter the required personal and contact details.
Provide educational qualifications and Engineering discipline information.
Select the appropriate Graduate or Diploma Apprentice category.

Apply for one discipline only. Applying for more than one discipline may make all your applications invalid. Category, discipline, qualification and mailing address cannot be changed after you submit.
Complete all mandatory application fields.
Upload the required documents in the formats specified by WBPDCL.
Review the application for accuracy.
Complete any applicable payment process specified by the recruitment portal.
Submit the application by 10 December 2026.
Download or save the application confirmation for future reference.
Monitor the WBPDCL website for subsequent recruitment and selection updates.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: WBPDCL has announced the online application schedule for both Graduate and Diploma Engineering Apprentice categories.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 60 Posts
content_sections.text: WBPDCL has announced 60 Technician Apprentice seats , divided equally between Graduate Engineering and Diploma Engineering categories. The Graduate Apprentice category offers the highest number of seats in Mechanical Engineering, followed by Electrical Engineering. Important: Mining Engineering has three vacancies in the Graduate Apprentice category, but no separate Mining Engineering vacancy is advertised under the Diploma Apprentice category in the short notification. Reservation follows the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. Candidates applying from states other than West Bengal will be treated as General category candidates.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: WBPDCL has issued Engagement Notification No. WBPDCL/Apprentice/2026/01 for 60 Graduate and Diploma Engineering Apprentice positions. The uploaded one-page short notice provides discipline-wise vacancies, application dates, training duration, application mode and NATS registration requirements. WBPDCL Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only candidates who passed their Graduation / Diploma in Engineering in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 can apply. Candidates who have already done apprenticeship training, are doing it now, are employed, or are registered for apprenticeship training elsewhere under the Apprentices Act are not eligible. Candidates should apply for one discipline only. Graduate Apprentice positions are intended for candidates holding a 4-year full-time Engineering Degree in the relevant discipline from an institute recognised by AICTE, passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. The notification prints no minimum percentage of marks. Where CGPA or a letter grade is awarded, the equivalent percentage must be shown in the application form, and a certificate to this effect from the University / Institute must be submitted at the interview. Diploma Apprentice positions are intended for candidates holding a 3-year full-time Engineering Diploma in the corresponding discipline from an institute recognised by AICTE or by the West Bengal State Council of Technical Education, passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. Yes. The Graduate Apprentice category is intended for eligible Engineering Degree holders in the advertised disciplines. The degree must be a 4-year full-time course from an AICTE-recognised institute, passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. Yes. Diploma Engineering candidates can apply for the relevant Technician (Diploma) Apprentice positions if they satisfy the prescribed eligibility conditions. The uploaded notification does not advertise a separate ITI Apprentice category. All 60 seats are allocated to Graduate Engineering and Diploma Engineering Apprentices. Therefore, candidates holding only an ITI qualification should not assume they are eligible for these vacancies.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 26 years as on 01.11.2026 for Technician Apprentice (Diploma in Engineering). For Technician Apprentice (Graduate in Engineering), the maximum age is 27 years as on 01.11.2026. The notification does not mention any category-wise age relaxation. The date of birth will be taken from the Birth Certificate issued by the Competent Authority or the Class X Certificate / Admit Card. No other proof of date of birth is accepted. Important: Age limits published for older WBPDCL apprenticeship recruitments should not automatically be treated as the age criteria for Notification No. WBPDCL/Apprentice/2026/01.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo one year of apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, as amended. The detailed notification sets the monthly stipend at Rs. 12,300 for Graduate Apprentices and Rs. 10,900 for Diploma Apprentices, at the rates prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Stipend Clarification: Apprenticeship stipends are different from salaries for regular Government or Public Sector employment. The amounts above are the rates printed in the detailed notification. WBPDCL will provide lodging, but apprentices pay for their own food (at subsidised rates in the plant / mines canteen) and their own electricity charges. 50% of the stipend is paid by the Government of India through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and the other 50% is paid by WBPDCL directly into the apprentice's bank account.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The uploaded short notice does not state a registration fee or category-wise fee exemption. Candidates should check the official online application portal for any applicable charges. No application fee amount should be assumed from earlier WBPDCL recruitment cycles.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The detailed notification sets out the selection process as follows: Candidates will be called for a Personal Interview (PI) based on their percentage of marks in Degree / Diploma Engineering, in a 1:5 ratio, following the reservation norms. Credentials will be checked before the Personal Interview. Candidates who do not meet the qualification will be rejected. Selected candidates must sign the Contract of Apprenticeship Training with WBPDCL online for one year of training. Interview call letters and all information will be sent only by e-mail or through the WBPDCL website. No hard copy will be posted, and no TA will be paid for attending the interview. Important: Shortlisting is based on Degree / Diploma marks (1:5 ratio) and is followed by a Personal Interview. The notification does not print a written test.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 NATS Registration
content_sections.text: WBPDCL has instructed candidates who have not yet registered with the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) to complete registration before applying through its website. Candidates already registered with the Board of Practical Training (Eastern Region) can proceed with the WBPDCL application according to the published instructions. NATS Official Portal: nats.education.gov.in WBPDCL Website: www.wbpdcl.co.in Important: NATS registration alone does not constitute submission of the WBPDCL recruitment application. Candidates must complete the separate WBPDCL online application within the prescribed registration window.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the official WBPDCL recruitment portal from 20 November to 10 December 2026 . Official Application Website: www.wbpdcl.co.in Online Application Start Date: 20 November 2026. Application Last Date: 10 December 2026. Only online applications will be accepted. The short notice expressly states that no other application mode is permitted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for WBPDCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep relevant documents ready for registration and subsequent verification. The detailed notification lists these mandatory documents: a duly signed application form, 02 copies of a recent passport-size photograph, the NATS enrolment number, and self-attested copies of date of birth proof (Matriculation Certificate / Mark Sheet / Admit Card or Birth Certificate) and Degree / Diploma certificates with all semester-wise / year-wise mark sheets. SC / ST / OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates must produce a caste certificate. The State NCL OBC certificate and the EWS income and asset certificate must be valid for FY 2026-27. Class 10 certificate or accepted date-of-birth proof. Relevant Engineering Degree certificate for Graduate Apprentice applicants. Relevant Engineering Diploma certificate for Diploma Apprentice applicants. Semester-wise or final marksheets. NATS registration or enrolment details. Recent passport-size photograph, if required. Scanned signature, if required. Valid photo identity proof. Category certificate, where reservation is claimed. Disability certificate, where applicable. Other documents prescribed in the detailed application instructions.

content_sections.heading: WBPDCL Apprentice Training Duration and Locations
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training period is one year under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Training will be conducted at WBPDCL power stations, projects and coal mines, according to the available training opportunities and placement decisions of the corporation. WBPDCL operates in electricity generation and coal mining and related activities in West Bengal and Jharkhand. Apprentices get the holidays on the WBPDCL holiday list, 14 days of Casual Leave and 10 days of Medical Leave per year. After the training, the apprenticeship contract ends automatically and WBPDCL has no obligation to offer employment. Employment Clarification: This notification advertises apprenticeship training rather than regular permanent employment. Candidates should review the detailed apprenticeship agreement and conditions for information about engagement and completion of training.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by The West Bengal Power Development Corporation Limited (WBPDCL) for engaging apprentices in various engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available in WBPDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 60 vacancies available for Technician Apprentice posts, distributed equally between Graduate and Diploma in Engineering candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available under this notification?
faq.answer: The available positions are Technician Apprentice (Graduate in Engineering) and Technician Apprentice (Diploma in Engineering) across multiple branches like Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, and Mining.

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting date to apply online?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can start submitting their online applications from 20 November 2026 onwards through the official WBPDCL recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to successfully submit the online application form for the WBPDCL Technician Apprentice recruitment is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate in Engineering or a Diploma in Engineering in relevant branches such as Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or Mining from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q7. Is prior registration mandatory before applying?
faq.answer: Yes, eligible candidates must have already registered with the Board of Practical Training - Eastern Region or the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) prior to applying.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the apprentice engagement?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be engaged as Technician Apprentices on a contract basis for a period of one year under the corporation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for WBPDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website of WBPDCL at www.wbpdcl.co.in to complete their submission.

faq.answer: The official notification details, online application links, and website references are conveniently provided in the Important Links section of this article for quick access.
